# SmartCam for Rokid AI Glasses

SmartCam records hands-free video on Rokid AI Glasses. Recordings stay on the glasses. The free app works without purchase.

## Features

- On-glasses recording controls, portrait video, and pause/resume
- Optional Pro upgrade: MARK important moments, Total Recall, and 1, 3, or 5 minute recording intervals
- One-time Pro activation through smartcam-pro.pages.dev

## Installation

Install the glasses APK. Open SmartCam and use the free recorder, or find the activation code on its Pro screen to buy the optional upgrade. Internet access is required for license activation and periodic status checks.
